create_CroissantBuilder: create a CroissantBuilder initialized from a Croissant metadata JSON file with specified record set names
build_CroissantBuilder_features: build TFDS-compatible features by inferring a FeaturesDict from a Croissant record set's fields
run_datatype_converter: run datatype_converter to convert a Croissant field to a TFDS-compatible numpy dtype or feature
run_CroissantBuilder_generate_examples: run _generate_examples to yield dataset examples from a Croissant record set as key-value pairs
run_CroissantBuilder_split_generators: run _split_generators to return a default split mapping from Croissant dataset records
